reader.ai_disclosure: Lá Số Việt uses methodological calculation and AI to organize, cross-reference, and interpret. Every significant insight is linked to chart data used.

reader.upgrade_title: Unlock the complete chart structure — 8 remaining sections
reader.upgrade_desc: The Comprehensive report expands all 12 palaces in detail, key star configurations, 4 life domains, and significant decadal/annual milestones.
reader.upgrade_price_notice: You already own the Natal Excerpt. Upgrade to Comprehensive for only 720 Lá instead of 960 Lá within 7 days from payment.
reader.timeline_note: Each cycle spans 10 years by lunar age. Only the current cycle has its own reading.
reader.chart_no_birth_time: Birth date and time are not shown.
reader.radar_label: Structural strength of the twelve palaces
reader.radar_caption: Each point is one palace. The further from the centre, the more its star pattern supports you.
reader.score_how_title: How is this number worked out?
reader.score_how_intro: It measures the palace's star pattern, not how good or bad your life is. The same chart always gives the same number.
reader.score_how_brightness_body: Exalted +12, prosperous +9, favourable +6, neutral +2, unfavourable -6, weak -9.
reader.score_how_support_body: Zuo Fu, You Bi, Wen Chang, Wen Qu, Tian Kui, Tian Yue are +4 each. Lu Cun +6, Tian Ma +3.
reader.score_how_block_body: Qing Yang, Tuo Luo, Huo Xing, Ling Xing, Di Kong, Di Jie are -5 each. Xun and Jie -4.
reader.score_how_facing_body: The opposite palace and the two triad palaces each add a third of their own score.
reader.score_how_borrow_body: A palace with no main star borrows the opposite palace's main stars at half weight.
reader.timeline_how_title: What does this strip tell you?
reader.timeline_how_body: Zi Wei divides a life into ten year cycles, each passing through a different palace. Whatever that palace governs comes to the front during those ten years. The strip does not rank cycles as good or bad. It shows where the weight of each stretch of life falls, so you can prepare instead of being surprised.
